$comment: Design Engineering Toolkit converter contract family — shared definitions. Major version 1. Platform-neutral: no platform name, no design-source node-id grammar, and no filesystem path is representable in these defs. Canonical ordering and hashing rules are normative for every emitter; see README.md in this directory.
title: Converter family shared definitions

schemaVersionMajor.description: Integer major version only. Additive minors are tracked in schemas/converter/README.md. Unknown majors must be rejected (SCHEMA_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED) — never best-effort parsed.

sourceId.description: Profile-declared source id. The mapping sourceId -> actual local path lives only in the per-run profile/env/CLI, never in any emitted payload.

revisionId.description: Opaque adapter-defined revision token (e.g. a VCS commit SHA of the audited checkout, or a fixture version tag).

evidenceId.description: Stable identity: 'e-' + first 12 lowercase hex of SHA-256 over kind, locator and sourceRevisionId joined by the canonical separator U+241F. Stable across re-runs on the same revision.

kind.description: Closed enum. 'config-declaration' means evidence read from the platform's own registration surface at the pinned revision; doc-only or screenshot-only evidence cannot justify proofLevel 'registered'.

locator.description: Scheme whitelist makes absolute filesystem paths unrepresentable. Schemes: source://<sourceId>/<path-relative-to-source-root>[#fragment]; design://<sourceId>/<adapter-defined-node-locator>; doc://<document-id>; https://... .

sourceRevisionId.description: Revision this evidence was read at; references sourceRevision.revisionId.

method.description: Tool/query that produced this evidence; adapter-defined vocabulary.

code.description: Closed converter-family code registry (21 codes). The 12 V1-family diagnostic codes stay in the V1 schemas; families keep independent majors. Blocking semantics: severity error = BLOCK_STAGE; NOT_VERIFIED = BLOCK_EXIT (blocks the stage-exit claim, not payload validity); other warnings are advisory unless a profile gate escalates them. Gates may escalate, never demote.

message.description: One actionable sentence: what failed + subject id + next action. Never the only signal — free text must not substitute for the structured code.

capabilityId.description: Formation rule is adapter-documented: <provider-namespace>/<type>[/<sub-type>...] lowercase. Segments allow underscores so a platform's own identifiers are carried faithfully (traceability beats renaming); the namespace prefix scopes the vocabulary. The same id recurs per appearance.

appearanceId.description: Adapter-faithful appearance identifier, lowercase. Use 'default' when the type has a single unnamed appearance. (id, appearanceId) is the unique capability identity.

proofLevel.description: Closed, totally ordered ladder. Promotion requires stage-specific evidence: registered needs >=1 config-declaration evidence from the platform's own registration surface at the pinned revision; structurally-mapped needs a pinned binding + mapped report section + legal nesting + zero blocking diagnostics; admin-roundtrip-verified and visually-verified can only be justified by later-stage receipts (G3/G4). Claiming a level above what pinned evidence justifies is a hard reject (EVIDENCE_MISSING) — never a silent downgrade.

mappingConfidence.description: Confidence never promotes a blocked mapping: status 'blocked' requires >=1 error-severity diagnostic naming the section regardless of confidence.
